children: New Era Energy & Digital signed a 20-year PPA with Vistra affiliate Luminant to supply a minimum 200 MW and up to 207 MW for Phase 1 of its Texas Critical Data Center, with power expected to be available in Q3 2027.
Locks in long-term firm power, de-risking Phase 1 execution and tenant leasing.
Adjacent gas plant reduces transmission risk and time-to-power.
Sets a project timeline; investors can benchmark milestones and cash needs.
Aligns incentives; modest dilution at project level, not corporate equity.
Provides pathway for expansion capital and power sourcing scalability.

This is an early-to-mid stage de-risking step for NUAI’s flagship TCDC, converting a power plan into contracted supply. Next, tenant pre-leases, financing terms, and construction milestones would turn this into a larger catalyst.
Based on the original press release from New Era Energy & Digital, Inc. distributed by GlobeNewswire.
